name: xjtu_batch2_15cell_p2dlite_rg_applicability_expansion
description: Batch-2 full 15-cell P2Dlite-RG applicability expansion. This stage generates all 15 Batch-2 P2Dlite-RG soft labels, audits radial gradients, trains/evaluates a 15-cell closed-set NN, then applies the D15-P3B theta projection repair for final scorecard.

batch2_scope.important_boundary: This is a Batch-2 15-cell closed-set applicability expansion, not held-out generalization and not experimental internal-state truth.

p2dlite_rg_generation.generation_note: Generate all 15 Batch-2 profiles. The output can be large because every profile keeps full-resolution cs_a/cs_c radial labels.

notes: P3C intentionally expands from P3/P3B 3-cell to all 15 Batch-2 cells.
It reuses the D15-P3 replay profiles under xjtu_batch2_replay_profiles_d15p3.
It does not overwrite D15-P3 3-cell outputs, P3B repair outputs, D15-P0/P1/P2, P4B/P5B/P5C, D12-S1K, or ASSB ModelFin_112.
The final acceptance should be based on projection-repaired metrics, while raw NN metrics must still be reported.
